bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement.

refutations.claim_made: the codes cannot be losslessly compressed much further
refutations.why: a lossless-coding claim measured by a coding bar. The level and the claim agree, so this refutation stands.

refutations.claim_made: joint coding of gate and up beats marginal coding
refutations.why: again a coding claim answered by a coding measurement: mutual information 0.00059 bits per weight pair.

refutations.claim_made: a shared low-rank basis can replace the MLP factors
refutations.source: negative_index: relative L2 0.9 including an oracle PCA
refutations.why: the claim was about REPLACING A FUNCTION, which is a capability claim, and it was refused at relative L2. An oracle at rank 64 also sat at 0.9, so the structural result is strong - but the BAR was local. Whether 0.9 relative L2 costs capability was never measured.

refutations.claim_made: larger quantization groups preserve the model
refutations.why: recorded CAPABILITY REFUTED, but the screen it failed is a local one. It also cuts aux bytes, which bill 0.000 ms/GB, so reopening it would buy size and not speed either way.

refutations.claim_made: no region is licensed to drop bits
refutations.why: THE CENTRAL DEFECT. Named 'capability' and gated on cosine 0.99 per region over 36 sampled regions. It licensed 27.7 MB, 0.28% of the token, against the 1773 MB that 60 TPS needs - a 64x shortfall produced by the bar, not by the model.

refutations.claim_made: the gate deserves literal storage and up/down do not
refutations.why: the claim was about relative sensitivity under matched damage, which is what was measured. Gate never exceeded 1.31x up. The level and the claim agree.

reopenable.rule: a refutation binds a claim only if it was measured at or above the claim's level. These were measured below CAPABILITY, so they do not by themselves refuse a capability-level candidate.
reopenable.this_is_not_permission_to_delete: nothing here says these approaches WORK. It says the evidence against them answers a different question than the one a capability claim asks. Reopening one requires the capability measurement that was never taken.

the_defect_this_prevents: CAPABILITY_INFORMATION_MAP is named for capability and gated on cosine 0.99 per region. It licensed 27.7 MB against the 1773 MB that 60 TPS requires - 64x short - and concluded that nothing is licensed to drop. The conclusion follows from the bar, not from the model.
the_rule: a candidate may not be refused at a level stricter than its claim. Local fidelity becomes DIAGNOSTIC for capability claims rather than authority.

what_each_cannot_establish.CAPABILITY: whether autonomous operation survives; a body can keep benchmark scores and lose structured tool use
what_each_cannot_establish.DOWNSTREAM_BEHAVIOR: capability on tasks not in the probe set, and nothing about long-horizon or tool-using behaviour
what_each_cannot_establish.HCLI_MISSION_CAPABILITY: general capability outside this laboratory's tasks
what_each_cannot_establish.LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_FIDELITY: capability. Zeroing 40% of a tensor's output rows moves the hidden state by 0.0059 of cosine, so this level is nearly flat exactly where the interesting question lives
what_each_cannot_establish.REPRESENTATION_FIDELITY: anything about behaviour; the codes are 93.5% independent information and matching them is neither necessary nor sufficient for capability

what_each_measures.CAPABILITY: whether the model still performs a task correctly
what_each_measures.HCLI_MISSION_CAPABILITY: whether it can still run this laboratory
what_each_measures.LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_FIDELITY: one layer's output against the incumbent's
what_each_measures.REPRESENTATION_FIDELITY: the stored numbers against the parent's numbers
